title: Pantry shift review
brief:
You schedule volunteers for a food pantry. Write an email to the volunteer lead recommending a preferred shift for the next four weeks. Fictional historical data for four recent weeks: Tuesday orders packed were 24, 30, 28, and 26 over two volunteer-hours each week. Thursday orders packed were 36, 33, 39, and 36 over three volunteer-hours each week. Compare total output and orders per volunteer-hour. You can staff either shift next month, and the pantry expects about 25 orders each week. Ask for the lead’s agreement by Friday.

Aim for 70 to 150 words. Return the complete original work directly in your answer. Do not sign or identify yourself. Do not use tools.

ab579459f519fe9f.text:
Subject: Recommend Tuesday for the next four weeks

Hi Volunteer Lead,

I recommend staffing Tuesday for the next four weeks. Either shift is available, and Tuesday’s average of 27 orders per week is enough to cover the roughly 25 we expect while using one fewer volunteer-hour each week.

Thursday had the higher total output over the four recent weeks, with 144 orders packed in 12 volunteer-hours. Tuesday packed 108 orders in 8 volunteer-hours. That gives Tuesday the higher rate at 13.5 orders per volunteer-hour, compared with 12 on Thursday. Tuesday’s lowest week was 24 orders, just one below our forecast.

Could you confirm by Friday that you agree with scheduling Tuesdays?

c689504274dcb7b3.text:
Subject: Tuesday packing shift for the next four weeks

Hi,

I recommend staffing the Tuesday packing shift for the next four weeks. Over the past four weeks, Tuesday packed 108 orders in 8 volunteer-hours, or 13.5 orders per volunteer-hour. Thursday packed 144 orders in 12 volunteer-hours, or 12 orders per volunteer-hour.

Thursday packed more orders overall. Tuesday packed more per volunteer-hour and averaged 27 orders per week, which is close to the 25 we expect. Tuesday met that target in three of the four weeks and came up one order short in the fourth.

Could you confirm by Friday whether you agree with scheduling Tuesdays?
